Battle blood (n.) – ''daishar'' (meaning, glory)

'''Daishar''' is a horse owned by [[Egwene al'Vere]]. His name means "glory" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==Appearance==
Daishar is a roan gelding. He is the size of a warhorse.

==Activities==
After being raised [[Amyrlin Seat]], Egwene decides that [[Bela]] is not a suitable horse for her new station. Daishar has carried Egwene several times; when talking with other [[Aes Sedai]]{{ref/book|7|11}}{{ref/book|7|12}}, meeting with [[Andor]]ans and [[Murandy|Murandians]]{{ref/book|8|17}}, [[Traveling]] to [[Tar Valon]]{{ref/book|8|30}} and scouting.{{ref/book|10|16}}
